root_cause.description: The /api/v4/certification/status endpoint returns internal CertificationEngine states (CERTIFIED, DEGRADED, FAILED) as the public overall_status instead of the canonical CertificationResultV3 contract states (FULLY_CERTIFIED, PARTIALLY_CERTIFIED, FINANCIAL_ONLY, BLOCKED, CONFLICT, NO_EVIDENCE).
root_cause.flow: DOM -> JS -> /api/v4/certification/status -> CertificationEngine.certify() -> MarketplacesCertification.status -> overall_status in response

canonical_mapping_required.financial_layer: Derived from CertificationEngine claims (reconciliation, ingresos, devoluciones, coverage, PNL equivalence, operational PNL)
canonical_mapping_required.settlement_layer: Derived from document_certification estado_legal/nivel_evidencia (SETTLEMENT_CERTIFIED for RIPLEY, NOT_APPLICABLE for others)
canonical_mapping_required.document_layer: Derived from document_certification estado_legal (LEGAL_DOCUMENT, DOCUMENT_CHAIN_CERTIFIED, TRANSACTION_CHAIN_CERTIFIED)
canonical_mapping_required.xml_layer: Derived from DTE coverage (XML_CERTIFIED if coverage=100%, XML_PRESENT_NOT_CERTIFIED if partial, XML_NOT_APPLICABLE if no DTE expected)
canonical_mapping_required.fiscal_layer: Derived from DTE/settlement evidence (FISCAL_BLOCKED_EXTERNAL for RIPLEY, FISCAL_CERTIFIED for ML/PARIS/FALABELLA with DTE coverage)
canonical_mapping_required.overall_derivation: Precedence: CONFLICT > BLOCKED > FULLY_CERTIFIED > PARTIALLY_CERTIFIED > FINANCIAL_ONLY > NO_EVIDENCE

critical_rule: financial valid + fiscal evidence absent/incomplete = PARTIALLY_CERTIFIED (NOT FAILED)

affected_marketplaces.FALABELLA_2026_05: Must return PARTIALLY_CERTIFIED or FINANCIAL_ONLY (not FAILED)
affected_marketplaces.FALABELLA_2026_04: Must return PARTIALLY_CERTIFIED or FINANCIAL_ONLY (not FAILED)
affected_marketplaces.ML: Must return PARTIALLY_CERTIFIED (reconciliation fails, classification fails)
